title: Spleen
junior: The spleen is a soft, purple organ on the left side of your belly. It filters your blood, removing old red blood cells and trapping germs.
definition: The spleen is a large bean-shaped secondary lymphoid organ that mainly contains lymphocytes and phagocytes.
structure: Lies in the upper left abdomen behind the stomach.
Red pulp (blood filtering) and white pulp (lymphoid tissue).
functions: Acts as a filter of the blood by trapping blood-borne micro-organisms.
Has a large reservoir of erythrocytes.
neetPoints: Secondary lymphoid organs: spleen, lymph nodes, tonsils, Peyer's patches of the small intestine and appendix — where lymphocytes interact with antigens.

mcqs.explanation: It is a secondary lymphoid organ where lymphocytes meet antigens.

mcqs.stem: Which is a function of the spleen?
mcqs.explanation: NCERT: it acts as a filter of blood by trapping blood-borne micro-organisms and holds a reservoir of erythrocytes.
